sections.label: Getting started
sections.heading: Getting started
items: Warm up in Boot Camp first (movement, cover, shooting), then try Combat Training before the tougher fights.
Know where your next piece of cover is before you need it, and keep an eye on flanking routes.
Every weapon has its own Active Reload timing. Nail it for a boost, and miss it and you're stuck for a moment.
Shotguns are for close range, rifles for safer distance, and heavy weapons for big enemies or crowds. Don't waste the good ammo.
Deal with enemies trying to flank you first. Watch what they're doing, not only where they're standing.
Falling back to reload behind better cover is smart. Only go for executions once the area is clear.
